open_issues.description: Review of the p.38 RF/converter region is recorded, but no new RF memberships were added. Source-to-functional-terminal mapping for the 7A8, aerial/loop/oscillator windings, tuning gangs and compensators remains open.
The three currently represented #12/#14 plate/grid groups were source-checked. Complete winding endpoints, 7B7 screen/cathode, trimmers and AVC connections remain open.

The four detector/audio groups and upper-diode symbol-level link were rechecked. The diode glyph is still not assigned to a socket pin; #17 lower branch, 7C6 external cathode return and full AVC routing remain open.
The 7C6 plate, 50L6 grid/cathode, #26 primary and #26/#27 secondary memberships are source-checked. #22/#25 routes, winding characteristics and speaker/model correlation remain open.

The filter/return groups, four internal heater-chain links and #30 40 Ω/lamp shunt groups were source-checked. Trace both mains paths, #16 switch, 35Z3 anode, #31 line capacitor and the complete heater endpoints before claiming a complete AC network.

The 22 currently represented net groups and 54 listed terminal memberships received a native 300-dpi page-38 cross-check. RF has no transcribed net groups; socket/winding crosswalks and unrepresented factory connections remain open.
Replace reduced-order model with validated tube, transformer and passive SPICE models.
